verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a public API: API keys, programmatic search over 138M+ papers, automated research reports, and an end-to-end Systematic Review endpoint. API access is listed on the pricing page, and all API functionality is mirrored via an MCP server. The probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the candidate paths, and the pack shows little endpoint-level reference detail. Missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec, detailed endpoint/schema reference, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
